policy.PASS: Exact/proven enough to activate as native behavior.
policy.STRONG: Substantial recovered evidence and live integration, but exact native behavior is not completely proven.
policy.UNKNOWN: Unresolved; runtime must not invent missing behavior.
policy.mechanics_guide: MajorMUD Complete Mechanics & Systems Guide is not formula authority and was not used as proof.

findings.formula: HEA/2 + level*class MinHP + level*race HP adjustment + con_adj + accumulated HP rolls + con_adj + MaxHP ability
findings.notes: The duplicate constitution adjustment is preserved because the native wccmmud.dll routine exposes it. Creation seeds accumulated HP rolls with the class maximum bonus-per-level cap.

findings.formula: type 0=0; types 1-4=MaxMana ability + MagicLevel*Level*2 + equipment mana cache + 6; type 5/Kai=max(0,Level-1)

findings.notes: One level per promotion; HP uses class minimum + race adjustment + 0..class cap roll + twice the constitution-adjustment delta. Mana delta is 0, MagicLevel*2, or +1 for type 5.
Decoded WCC class/race experience percentages apply before the authoritative character/class XP ledgers are updated.

findings.formula: normal Fix(((Level+20)*Health)/750); resting Fix(((Level+20)*Health)/500); HPRegen percentage applied afterward
findings.unresolved: Exact native tick phase/host-clock alignment remains unproven.

findings.formula: Casting stat by magic type: INT, WIL, Fix((INT+WIL)/2), CHA, or Kai/type-5 seed; then Fix((((Level+20)*seed)*(MagicLevel+2))/1650) with MPRegen modifier semantics.
findings.unresolved: Full type-5/Kai MPRegen branch ordering and exact native timer phase remain below PASS confidence.

findings.conflict_resolution: An older screenshot-derived note reversed INT/WIL weighting. Pass 9 follows the retained executable MMUD Explorer CalcMR implementation and keeps the result STRONG, not PASS, until native DLL ordering is independently recovered.

findings.formula: Fix(Level/5) + Fix((Charm-50)/5) + Fix((Agility-50)/3) + PlusDodge; if encumbrancePct < 33, add 10-Fix(encumbrancePct/10)
findings.unresolved: Race/class ownership of PlusDodge is not promoted where decoded ability-slot mapping is ambiguous. Final Dodge-vs-Accuracy and 95% cap remain separately proven Combat behavior.

findings.formula: level progression +20 + Fix(AGI/4) + Fix(INT/8) + Fix(Charm/6), class/race adjustments, then Ability 27

findings.notes: Pass 9 prevents quest/acquired ability values from being counted twice when the 0155 projection already contains ability + equipment totals. Direct equipment/ability additive projection remains STRONG.

Retained MMUD Explorer evidence contains two materially different Picklocks formula families. The exact stock branch/ownership is not sufficiently disambiguated, so Pass 9 does not activate a synthetic base Picklocks formula.

The retained CalcCPLevel calculator is a useful lead but does not establish the authoritative server promotion row schedule. Runtime continues to require evidence-promoted progression rows and fails closed when absent.

Current death/corpse/respawn ownership is STRONGLY CORRELATED, but native XP loss, partial gold loss, corpse decay, resurrection penalties/order, status cleanup, alternate respawn, third-party looting, and exact lives semantics remain unresolved. Pass 9 does not promote or invent them.

Exact native ordering among permanent race/class modifiers, acquired abilities, equipment, auras/status effects, and base-stat-derived values remains unresolved beyond the direct mappings already promoted.
